name: Iguchi Himena
source:
The queen bee at Oujo, the 'King's Castle,' the premier brothel in Sarubotoke Island's red-light district. 
Attracted by tales of its unparalleled earnings, Himena left the hustle of Tokyo for the allure of Sarubotoke Island. Sporting the striking, [I]Shiro-Gyaru[/i] fashion, she commands attention with her bold style and infectious smile. Her dazzling looks and captivating presence keep her admirers returning, ensuring her spot at the top.

"Hey, feel like getting a little cozy with Hime?"
